text: Frivolous means silly and not important. Here, people long ago said Father's Day was just a silly trick, not worth celebrating.
Niche means meant for a small, special group of people. Here, it means holidays so unusual that only a few people care about them.
To anoint is to choose something and give it a special title or honor. The writer asks who gets to pick all these holidays.
Thanksgiving is an American holiday in November. Families gather for a big meal, often with turkey, and say what they are thankful for.
To gobble up means to eat something quickly and eagerly. The word also copies the noise a turkey makes.
Absurd means so silly that it makes no sense. A holiday for Absurdity Day is a joke that is also real.
Absurdity is the state of being silly or senseless. It comes from the same family as the word absurd.
Sanctity means being holy or very precious and worth great respect. It is a serious word, which is why the writer calls that day very serious.
A scheduling conflict is when two events are set for the same time or day. Here, a day of remembrance lands on the same date as a cereal day.
Remembrance means a time set aside to think about and honor people who are gone.
Coincides means happens at the same time. Two days that coincide fall on the same date.
Uninspiring means dull and not exciting. A name that is uninspiring does not make you curious.
A federal holiday is an official day off made by the national government. Few exist, unlike made-up national days.
Formalised means made official, often by law. The writer uses the British spelling; Americans write formalized.
Juneteenth is a U.S. holiday on June 19th. It marks the end of slavery in America.
To commemorate is to remember an important event or person with a special day or ceremony.
The United Nations is a group of nearly every country in the world. They work together on problems like peace and health.
Designates means officially picks or names something for a purpose.
To publicise is to tell many people about something so they notice it. Americans spell it publicize.
Goofy means silly and playful in a funny way.
Self-appointed means someone gave themselves a job or power, instead of being chosen by others.
National Day Calendar is a company that collects and picks fun national days, like National Pizza Day.
Applications are requests to be chosen for something. Here, they are suggestions for new days.
A selection process is the set of steps used to choose a few things from many.
Charities are groups that raise money or awareness to help people or causes.
To boost sales means to help a business sell more. Companies like days that make people think of their products.
Brands are the names and logos companies use to sell their products, like the name on a soda or sneaker.
Relevant means connected to the topic at hand. A relevant day for a pizza brand would be National Pizza Day.
To trend means to become very popular online for a short time, with lots of people posting about it.
Breaking news is a big story that just happened and is being reported right now.
To predate means to come before something else in time. These holidays are older than the internet.
Raisin-growers are farmers who grow grapes that are dried to make raisins.
A gimmick is a clever trick used to get attention or sell things.
Emerged means came into view or came into being, like a new idea appearing.
Family-oriented means centered on families and the people in them.
Harmless means not likely to hurt anyone or anything.
A hermit is a person who chooses to live alone, away from other people.
Catholic describes a member of the Catholic Church, the largest group of Christians in the world.
Intently means with strong focus. Staring intently means looking very hard without looking away.
Here, observing a holiday means marking it or celebrating it in some way.
Foolish means silly or unwise. The writer jokes that some of these days might be totally foolish.
